author: Skquid
body:
This will be a collection thread on any evidence regarding Yordan98. Although Kill aura is the most suspected hack, any evidence for any other bannable offenses are welcomed with opened arms. Keep in mind that this player has been banned twice, and has 11 reports for PvP related hacking, (hacked client, aimbot, kill aura, reach, etc.) and has played for a total of one day. He joined 2 years ago, but suddenly started playing very actively on this server again a few weeks ago.

(1:55 5:33 5:47)- you should skip these, but you can look at them if you're still not sure. 7:00- watch head movement. 7:04- Head snap.
https://youtu.be/92fnIubor7o

head movement at :17, tactics and fighting at :31, Head snap and tracking at 1:04
https://youtu.be/smZKk7nKVQk

head movement at 1:12, tracking at 1:56, preemptive hits at 2:02, lunge and spin at 2:30
https://youtu.be/6G3PYfwUlfU

Also keep in mind that 3 or 4 other staff have worked on this case, each with claims of suspicious head snaps and movement. 

In my personal opinion, this player is hacking with an auto clicker and/or aim assist. I have just reviewed my evidence videoes today, and I realize many areas I have missed. Other staff members have evidence as well. If you are one of them, please post down below.
